accountDetails.title: Pangani akaunti yanu
accountDetails.heading: Pangani akaunti yanu
accountDetails.intro: Izi ndizofunikira. Pitirizani kupanga akaunti yanu pa {{ server_name }}. Simungathe kusintha izi pambuyo pake.
accountDetails.errorRequired: Izi ndizofunikira. Chonde perekani dzina lolowera
accountDetails.errorInvalidCharacters: Dzina lolowera siloyenera, chonde gwiritsani ntchito {{ allowed_characters }} zokha
redirectConfirm.title: Pitirizani ku akaunti yanu
redirectConfirm.heading: Pitirizani ku akaunti yanu
redirectConfirm.trust: Kupitiriza kudzapatsa {{ display_url }} mwayi wopeza akaunti yanu.
ssoError.title: Kutsimikizira kwalephera
ssoError.heading: Panali cholakwika
ssoError.emailLinkHint: Ngati mukuwona tsambali mutadina ulalo womwe watumizidwa kwa inu kudzera pa imelo, onetsetsani kuti mukudina ulalo wotsimikizira kamodzi kokha, komanso kuti mumatsegula ulalo wotsimikizira mu kasitomala yemwe mukulowera.
ssoError.retryHint: Yesani kulowanso ku Pangea Chat ndipo ngati vuto likupitirira chonde lemberani woyang'anira seva.
authSuccess.title: Zatheka!
authSuccess.mayClose: Mutha kutseka zenera ili ndikubwerera ku pulogalamu
registrationSuccess.title: Kutsimikizira Kwapambana
registrationSuccess.body: Zabwino zonse! Imelo yanu yatsimikiziridwa. Chonde bwererani ku pulogalamu kuti mulowe!
passwordResetConfirm.title: Kutsimikizira kukonzanso mawu achinsinsi
passwordResetConfirm.intro: Mwafunsa kuti mukonzenso mawu achinsinsi a akaunti yanu ya Pangea Chat. Dinani ulalo womwe uli pansipa kuti mutsimikizire izi.
passwordResetConfirm.disclaimer: Ngati simunafune kuchita izi, chonde tsekani tsambali ndipo mawu achinsinsi anu sadzasinthidwa.
